title: In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, an authenticated user with permission to create and run playbooks could start…
description: Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0 contain a vulnerability where an authenticated user with permission to create and run playbooks can start child playbooks on containers outside their authorized label or repository scope. This occurs because the identity used to authorize the child playbook run is not bound to the parent playbook execution context, potentially exposing container data and affecting automation beyond the user's scope.
